reference_findings.implication_for_experiment: The deck separates product-level matching from SKU-level matching: it first picks one matching product, then compares SKUs when producing the output file. It does not specify an embedding model or define title+SKU versus SKU-only evaluation.

quoted_japanese: au PAYマーケットと楽天市場でSKUの区切りが異なるため、同一SKUの特定が難しいケースがあります。
楽天 SKU： 100×80cm / ブルー / あり ←不一致
reference_findings.details: The example has Rakuten split into three dimensions (size, color, lace curtain yes/no), while au has two; the lace-curtain-included option is a separate product on au. Treat this as a synthetic scenario candidate for unmatched/ambiguous variants. Page 35 shows Rakuten's unselected-SKU price as a range, 1,940〜2,780円.

reference_findings.topic: Three proposed handling choices; decision status

options.label: 「～」（波線）を許容する
options.behavior: Only select Rakuten size×color SKUs also present on au; output the price range 1,940〜2,780円.
options.tradeoff: Simple and fewest SKUs; price is a range and lace inclusion difference is not reflected.

options.label: 価格が最も近い条件で絞り込む
options.behavior: Choose the Rakuten lace yes/no condition whose price is closest to au, output a single price; example 2,780円 (yes).
options.tradeoff: Requires price comparison; omits the unselected option and can match products that differ in lace inclusion.

options.label: auの別URL（別バージョン）も収集する
options.behavior: Collect separate au product URLs (e.g. 2-piece/4-piece variants), pair each with Rakuten SKUs, and output per-SKU prices (example: yes 2,780円 / no 1,940円).
options.tradeoff: Can match each of Rakuten's three dimensions 1:1 and include lace-related price differences; requires finding/linking additional au products and increases product count/accesses.

reference_findings.decision_status: Undecided in this deck. It explicitly asks the client to select one of options 1–3; no chosen option is shown.

scope_and_conflicts.experiment_alignment: The document supports testing SKU normalization and SKU-level matching errors, especially mismatched option dimensionality. It does not establish that title+SKU or SKU-only embeddings are the production method.
scope_and_conflicts.potential_scope_conflict: If the experiment treats each listing SKU as the primary matching unit, note that the deck's stated flow selects a product first and judges SKU equality at file-output time. Keep those stages distinct when interpreting results.
scope_and_conflicts.reference_limit: Pages 33–36 are illustrative specification slides, not evidence that the three option choices were approved or implemented.
